purpose: Document official SELAE public surfaces for Loteria Nacional geography, sales and prize-distribution research without inferring unavailable data.

sales.availabilityRule: Persist values only when the requested draw returns explicit official rows. If SELAE says information is unavailable or returns an empty table, store unavailable; never infer or carry forward another draw.

allocation.availabilityRule: Use only explicit official rows for the exact draw; no interpolation between draws.

firstPrizePointsOfSale.semantics: Distribution/location evidence for the first prize only. It is not proof of total sales by location and must not be converted into sales volume or predictive weight.

verifiedExamples.observation: Official page lists multiple related points of sale across provinces.
Official page lists web and physical points of sale; online distribution must remain a separate channel category.
Official page lists related points of sale in several provinces.

officialStatistics.coverageStatement: SELAE states the displayed statistics are calculated from draws since 2009-01-01.
officialStatistics.useRule: Treat as descriptive reference only; never as predictive evidence or as a substitute for canonical draw-level results.
